# CLI Reference

Справочник генерируется скриптом `scripts/generate-cli-reference.mjs` из реестра commander (`src/adapters/cli/cli-entry.ts`): на каждую команду — фактический вывод `wolf <path> --help` собранного CLI. Ручные правки файла бесполезны: guard-тест `tests/unit/cli-reference-guard.test.ts` сверяет файл с реестром.

Регенерация: `node scripts/generate-cli-reference.mjs` (то же делает `npm run docs:build`).

## Команды

### wolf init

```text
Usage: wolf init [options]

Initialize Mr. Wolf memory for this project (model pinning is opt-in via
--model)

Options:
  --platform <ids>  explicit platform list (comma-separated: opencode,claude);
                    replaces the current set
  --model <id>      model for Mr.Wolf and its agents (<providerID>/<modelID>);
                    opt-in — by default model lines are omitted
  --full            render the full base set (agents/skills/commands/plugins);
                    default is the minimal set (default: false)
  --yes             re-init: apply the plan without interactive confirmation
                    (default: false)
  --recreate        backup a corrupted .wolf/config.yaml and re-create it from
                    defaults (default: false)
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

### wolf sync

```text
Usage: wolf sync [options]

Re-render the wolf base set (stamped files only; memory untouched)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf uninstall

```text
Usage: wolf uninstall [options]

Remove wolf-managed files from this project (prints plan first; --yes executes)

Options:
  --yes       execute the plan (without it — plan only, nothing is written)
              (default: false)
  --purge     with --yes: also erase .wolf/ (project memory) (default: false)
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf add

```text
Usage: wolf add [options]

Add a memory object

Options:
  --type <type>              Memory type (choices: "rule", "lesson",
                             "decision", "thread", "complaint", "tool", "note",
                             "face")
  --title <title>            Title
  --body <body>              Body text
  --tags <tags>              Comma-separated tags
  --confidence <confidence>  Confidence level (low|medium|high)
  --importance <n>           Importance from 0 to 1
  --set <k=v>                Extra field key=value (repeatable; "[a,b]" value
                             is a string array) (default: [])
  --scope <scope>            Scope field for types that declare one (rule:
                             project|global; also main or worktree:<name>)
  --facet <facet>            Note facet (required for note;
                             howto|pitfall|context|metric|history|legacy|constraint|proposal)
  --created-by <actor>       Creator actor (default: env WOLF_ACTOR, else
                             user:cli)
  -h, --help                 display help for command
```

### wolf list

```text
Usage: wolf list [options]

List memory objects

Options:
  --type <type>      Filter by type
  --status <status>  Filter by status
  --stale            List stale objects (not updated in 30 days) (default:
                     false)
  --facet <facet>    Filter by facet
                     (howto|pitfall|context|metric|history|legacy|constraint|proposal)
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

### wolf get

```text
Usage: wolf get [options] <id>

Get a memory object by id

Arguments:
  id          Memory object id

Options:
  --latest    Follow the superseded_by chain to the current object (default:
              false)
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf search

```text
Usage: wolf search [options] <query>

Search memory objects

Arguments:
  query                      Search query

Options:
  --type <type>              Filter by type
  --facet <facet>            Filter by facet
                             (howto|pitfall|context|metric|history|legacy|constraint|proposal)
  --status <status>          Filter by status
  --tag <tag>                Filter by tag (repeatable) (default: [])
  --confidence <confidence>  Filter by confidence (low|medium|high)
  --min-importance <n>       Minimum importance
  --max-importance <n>       Maximum importance
  --created-after <iso>      Created on or after date
  --created-before <iso>     Created on or before date
  --limit <n>                Maximum results
  --file-path <path>         Filter by related/source file path
  --hide-superseded          Hide superseded objects (shown and marked
                             [superseded] by default) (default: false)
  --include-superseded       Deprecated no-op: superseded objects are shown by
                             default (default: false)
  -h, --help                 display help for command
```

### wolf relation

```text
Usage: wolf relation [options] [command]

Manage relations between memory objects

Options:
  -h, --help                                    display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] <subject> <predicate> <object>  Record a relation between two memory objects
  list [options]                                List relations (--of <id>: both directions of a memory object)
  remove <id>                                   Remove a relation by id (appends a compensating record)
  help [command]                                display help for command
```

#### wolf relation add

```text
Usage: wolf relation add [options] <subject> <predicate> <object>

Record a relation between two memory objects

Arguments:
  subject            Subject memory object id
  predicate          Relation predicate
  object             Object memory object id

Options:
  --source <source>  Relation source (default: "agent")
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

```text
Usage: wolf relation list [options]

List relations (--of <id>: both directions of a memory object)

Options:
  --of <id>   Filter by memory object id (subject or object side)
  --json      Output JSON
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

#### wolf relation remove

```text
Usage: wolf relation remove [options] <id>

  id          Relation id (see: relation list)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf face

```text
Usage: wolf face [options] [command]

Manage faces (versioned agent playbooks)

Options:
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  new [options] <owner_skill>         Create a new face version (steward-only;
                                      guard inside the use-case)
  restore [options] <owner_skill>     Restore an old version as a NEW one
                                      (owner; linear history, REQ-05)
  breakglass [options] <owner_skill>  Emergency rollback by the owner (steward
                                      not involved; logged, REQ-07)
  recover [options] <op_id>           Resume an interrupted face operation by
                                      op id (--abort: archive the candidate,
                                      pre-activation only)
  migrate [options]                   Migrate legacy playbook notes to faces
                                      (idempotent, REQ-02)
  list [options]                      List faces: owner_skill, current version,
                                      id, status
  history [options] <owner_skill>     Show version history of a face (newest
                                      first)
  show [options] <owner_skill>        Show the current face version: metadata
                                      and body
  resolve [options] <owner_skill>     Resolve the canonical active face for an
                                      agent (JSON: {ok, face|error}; exit 1 on
                                      miss/conflict)
  help [command]                      display help for command
```

#### wolf face new

```text
Usage: wolf face new [options] <owner_skill>

Create a new face version (steward-only; guard inside the use-case)

Arguments:
  owner_skill           Owner skill, e.g. skill:my-agent

Options:
  --reason <t>          Why this version exists (REQ-04)
  --body <md>           Face body markdown
  --file <path>         Read face body from a file (alternative to --body)
  --title <title>       Face title (default: "Face: <owner_skill>")
  --tags <tags>         Comma-separated tags
  --from-proposal <id>  Link the new version to a proposal (relation: proposes)
  --op-id <id>          Operation id: resume an interrupted mutation (default:
                        generated faceop-<ts>-<rand4>)
  --minimal-change <t>  G17: what exactly changes (REQ-06)
  --boundaries <t>      G17: what does NOT change (essence/frame)
  --example-helps <t>   G17: example that benefits from the change
  --example-keep <t>    G17: example that must keep working
  --verification <t>    G17: how to verify the mutation
  --rollback <t>        G17: how to roll back
  -h, --help            display help for command
```

#### wolf face restore

```text
Usage: wolf face restore [options] <owner_skill>
```

### wolf propose


### wolf tool

```text
Usage: wolf tool [options] [command]

Tool librarian: add/register/list/use/expose/deprecate/revive

Options:
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  register [options] <script-path>  Register a script as tool memory object
                                    (copies script to .wolf/tools/)
  add [options] <script-path>       Register a script as tool memory object
                                    (synonym for register)
  list [options]                    List registered tools
  use <name-or-id>                  Mark tool as used (increments usage_count,
                                    prints contract reminder)
  expose <name-or-id>               (Re)generate
                                    .opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md from tool
                                    object (idempotent)
  deprecate [options] <name-or-id>  Deprecate a tool (requires reason)
  revive <name-or-id>               Revive a deprecated tool (deprecated →
                                    active)
  stats                             Usage counters per tool + reuse economy
                                    (signal log + legacy run-log)
  help [command]                    display help for command
```

#### wolf tool register

### wolf complain

```text
Usage: wolf complain [options]

File a complaint about a rule/playbook/agent as a memory object (type
complaint, status open)

Options:
  --about <about>        Complaint target: agent id, skill:<name> or existing
                         mem-id
  --rule <rule>          Which rule is bad (pointer + what it requires)
  --evidence <evidence>  Proof: verbatim quote + what happened
                         (file/test/numbers)
  --text <text>          Deprecated alias for --evidence
  --proposal <proposal>  Proposed change to the rule
  --kind <kind>          Complaint kind: technical | behavioral (default:
                         heuristic by --about)
  --created-by <actor>   Creator actor (default: env WOLF_ACTOR, else user:cli)
  -h, --help             display help for command
```

```text
Usage: wolf analytics [options]

Analytics state window: ledgers (memory/tools/rules), weekly activity, agents,
steward, councils, outliers, readiness, coordination, campaigns, delivery,
acceptance, effectiveness, dashboard

Options:
  --view <view>      Analytics view (choices: "memory", "tools", "rules",
                     "weeklyActivity", "agents", "steward", "outliers",
                     "readiness", "councils", "coordination", "campaign",
                     "delivery", "acceptance", "effectiveness", "dashboard",
                     "all", default: "all")
  --class <class>    Memory lifecycle filter (choices: "new", "sleeper",
                     "workhorse", "dead")
  --type <type>      Memory type filter
  --origin <origin>  Tool origin filter (choices: "script", "native")
  --agent <agent>    Agent name filter
  --silent           Rules view: only silent rules (default: false)
  --top <n>          Row limit (default: 20)
  --weeks <n>        Weekly activity window in weeks (default: 8)
  --snapshot         Effectiveness view: append the report to
                     .wolf/metrics/effectiveness-snapshots.jsonl (default:
                     false)
  --json             Machine-readable JSON output (default: false)
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

### wolf upgrade

```text
Usage: wolf upgrade [options]

Upgrade the global wolf installation to the latest npm version (runs npm
install -g mister-wolf@latest); --check only compares versions, no install

Options:
  --check     Only check for a newer version, do not install anything
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf doctor

```text
Usage: wolf doctor [options]

Check all registered projects: binary vs schema version, platform configs,
prune dead entries

Options:
  --repair    repair storage in the current project: rebuild index, backfill
              memory.added events (default: false)
  --dry-run   with --repair: print the plan without writing (default: false)
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

```text
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf claim

```text
Usage: wolf claim [options] [command]

Single-writer claims on shared artifacts (TASK briefs, plans, reports,
worktrees)

Options:
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  acquire <artifact>              Atomically acquire artifact ownership (second
                                  concurrent writer is rejected)
  heartbeat [options] <artifact>  Refresh the claim heartbeat (keeps a
                                  long-running claim fresh within the 10-minute
                                  window)
  release [options] <artifact>    Release artifact ownership (owner-only) or
                                  transfer it explicitly
  list                            List active claims (who/when/what, from the
                                  registry files)
  help [command]                  display help for command
```

#### wolf claim acquire

```text
Usage: wolf claim acquire [options] <artifact>

Atomically acquire artifact ownership (second concurrent writer is rejected)

Arguments:
  artifact    Artifact id, e.g. "dev:<date>-<slug>" or "worktree:w-<12hex>"

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

#### wolf claim heartbeat

```text
Usage: wolf claim heartbeat [options] <artifact>

Refresh the claim heartbeat (keeps a long-running claim fresh within the
10-minute window)

Arguments:
  artifact           Artifact id whose claim heartbeat to refresh

Options:
  --session <id>     Assert the claim session (2.18.4): refuse on mismatch
  --pid <n>          Record writer pid in the heartbeat (debug, not auth)
  --claim-token <t>  Assert the claim token (2.18.4): refuse after re-acquire
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

#### wolf claim release

```text
Usage: wolf claim release [options] <artifact>

Release artifact ownership (owner-only) or transfer it explicitly

Arguments:
  artifact               Artifact id to release

Options:
  --transfer-to <actor>  Hand ownership over to another actor instead of
                         dropping the claim
  -h, --help             display help for command
```

#### wolf claim list

```text
Usage: wolf claim list [options]

List active claims (who/when/what, from the registry files)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### wolf scaffold (hidden)

```text
Usage: wolf scaffold [options] <kind> <name>

Scaffold opencode frame (agent|skill|command) + playbook in Wolf memory

Arguments:
  kind                  Frame kind (choices: "agent", "skill", "command",
                        "artifact")
  name                  Frame name

Options:
  --persona <text>      Agent frame body text (agent only)
  --model <model>       Agent frontmatter model (agent only)
  --from-playbook <id>  Reuse existing playbook id instead of creating a new
                        one
  --fix                 Fix profile for kind=artifact: requirements.md +
                        plan.md only (default: false)
  --created-by <actor>  Creator actor (default: env WOLF_ACTOR, else user:cli)
  -h, --help            display help for command
```

### wolf update (hidden)

```text
Usage: wolf update [options] <id>

Update triage fields of a memory object (whitelist: --set triage|resolution,
--inc dispatch_ages|corroborations, --tags append)

Arguments:
  id               Memory object id

Options:
  --set <k=v>      Set a triage field: triage|resolution (repeatable) (default:
                   [])
  --inc <field=n>  Increment monotonic counter by integer n > 0:
                   dispatch_ages|corroborations (repeatable) (default: [])
  --tags <tags>    Append comma-separated tags
  --actor <actor>  Actor performing the update (default: "user:cli")
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### wolf task-eval (hidden)

```text
Usage: wolf task-eval [options]

Record a task verdict into the signal log (event task_evaluated)

Options:
  --verdict <verdict>    Task verdict (choices: "accepted", "rejected",
                         "partial", "inconclusive")
  --scorer <scorer>      Who evaluated the task (choices: "human",
                         "deterministic", "llm_judge", "hidden_tests", default:
                         "human")
  --session <id>         Session id
  --task-id <id>         Task id
  --campaign <id>        Campaign id (written as detail.campaign_id)
  --note <text>          Free-form note
  --criteria-passed <n>  Criteria passed count
  --criteria-total <m>   Criteria total count
  --critical-failure     Mark a critical failure (default: false)
  -h, --help             display help for command
```

### Скрытые синонимы analytics (§6.5)

- `wolf insights` — скрытый синоним: `analytics --view readiness`
- `wolf effectiveness` — скрытый синоним: `analytics --view effectiveness`
- `wolf dashboard` — скрытый синоним: `analytics --view dashboard`
